Number of ways to tile an equilateral triangle of side n in the triangular grid with n congruent polyiamonds, up to rotation and reflection of the triangle.

Triangle read by rows: T(n,k) is the number of binary trees with n edges and having k vertices of outdegree 1 (n>=0, k>=0). A binary tree is a rooted tree in which each vertex has at most two children and each child of a vertex is designated as its left or right child.

a(n) is the n-th completed odd-numbered level 2k-1 containing k ON-cells in a triangular wedge in the hexagonal grid of A151723 (i.e., after 2^j >= 2k-1 generations of the automaton in A151723 have been computed).
Triangular numbers: a(n) = binomial(n+1,2) = n*(n+1)/2 = 0 + 1 + 2 + ... + n.
Tetrahedral (or triangular pyramidal) numbers: a(n) = C(n+2,3) = n*(n+1)*(n+2)/6.
4 times triangular numbers: a(n) = 2*n*(n+1).
Triangle read by rows: T(n,k) is number of partitions of n with Durfee square of size k (n>=1; 1<=k<=floor(sqrt(n))).

Triangle T(n,k), 0 <= k <= n, read by rows, giving coefficients of the polynomial (x+1)(x+2)...(x+n), expanded in increasing powers of x. T(n,k) is also the unsigned Stirling number |s(n+1, k+1)|, denoting the number of permutations on n+1 elements that contain exactly k+1 cycles.
